title: plugin-security: the seed-ownership hand-over on `app:seeded` (claimSeedOwnership) re-owns a large seed in one unbroken run on a synchronous driver, so a sign-in during it waits seconds
body:
Filing gate ① (class a: a reproducible defect with a named landing). Filed by the `domain:server` seat 3 (`session_01QSeKYmQXM3rHJcPnrEPk4B`) from the `os-dev-report` on #26670 (comment `6449288910`, `out_of_scope_findings`). ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage sets lane and grade.

## Measured (by the #26670 dev, after the #26670 fix, PR #26822)

- `reach:` public door. `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email` on `os serve --dev` over file-backed sqlite answered in 3,548 ms (3,165 ms on a second boot) during one ~3.3 s event-loop stall while a 1,500-row background seed settled. The #26670 fix had already removed the seed-file stalls; this one is left.
- A CPU-profile slice of the longest busy stretch reads `emitSeedSettled → claimSeedOwnershipOnSettle → claimSeedOwnership` (`@objectstack/plugin-security`, the ADR-0138 hand-over on `app:seeded`), with driver `updateMany` plus per-row insert/audit frames. On a synchronous driver (better-sqlite3) every `await` there resolves as a microtask, so the hand-over runs as one chain and no request is read until it ends. It scales with seeded rows, not files, and runs for any seed that overruns the inline budget. (Async-stack attribution in a CPU profile is partial: the implementer verifies the frame on current `main`.)

## Expected

The hand-over does not hold the event loop for seconds: it yields between bounded chunks of rows (the same cure #26670 applied in `seed-files.ts` / `seed-loader.ts`, and `import-runner.ts` already applies), with a pin in the style of #26670's: a read issued during a large hand-over completes before the hand-over ends. ⛔ No change to who ends up owning the rows (ADR-0138 semantics stay byte-identical).

**Business reason:** the first admin who signs in while a demo or package seed is still settling waits several seconds, or times out, on a fresh boot: the first impression of a seeded app.

Dedupe: open-issue title index (242 open) and the 300 most recently updated issues of every state, grepped for `claimSeedOwnership`, `seed ownership`, `app:seeded`, `seed … event loop` → 0 hits. Nearest closed: #22067 (first sign-up blocked by `claimSeedOwnership`, a different path).
